explication: MOLGENIS EMX2 is a customizable scientific-data platform. Its principal workflow is to define a schema, use the generated database application and APIs to collect or update data, then query and share it through web apps or linked-data interfaces. The tree also shows domain apps for catalogues, biobank discovery, and provider dashboards, plus FAIR harvesting. The README documents capabilities beyond the sampled implementation; those branches are included at their supported paths, while uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
